seo_desc: Kumbh Mela 2027 for international visitors: Haridwar Ardh Kumbh and Nashik Simhastha bathing dates, crowds and safety, where to stay, and how to plan.
label: Kumbh Mela 2027
blurb: Haridwar and Nashik 2027 bathing dates, crowds and a Kumbh plan
tag: Two Kumbhs in 2027 — and how to see one well.
sub: Haridwar holds its Ardh Kumbh from 14 January to 20 April 2027, and the Nashik–Trimbakeshwar Simhastha has its main baths in August and September 2027. Here are the announced bathing dates, what an Amrit Snan is, an honest word on crowds, and how to plan a Kumbh visit from Delhi. Written by a travel company based in the Himalaya.
hero_alt: The ghats of Har Ki Pauri in Haridwar by day, temples on the ghat in the evening, a large evening gathering by the Ganga and the Har Ki Pauri clock tower
q: When and where is the next Kumbh Mela?
answer: The next Kumbh Melas are in 2027. Haridwar's Ardh Kumbh runs from 14 January to 20 April 2027, with the main Amrit Snan bathing days on 6 March, 8 March and 14 April. The Nashik–Trimbakeshwar Simhastha opens on 31 October 2026, with its main baths on 2 August, 31 August and 11–12 September 2027. Foreigners are welcome; we plan Haridwar visits from Delhi with a private car and driver.

sections.lead: Maharashtra's Simhastha Kumbh is held at Nashik and Trimbakeshwar, on the Godavari river. The Maharashtra Government announced its schedule in June 2025 (reported by PTI):
items: Opening: 31 October 2026
The Kumbh opens with flag hoisting (Dhwajarohan) at Trimbakeshwar and at Ramkund in Nashik.
Nagar Pradakshina: 29 July 2027

Amrut Snan: 2 Aug, 31 Aug, 11–12 Sep 2027

sections.lead: UNESCO added the Kumbh Mela to its Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in December 2017, describing it as the largest peaceful congregation of pilgrims on earth. It is held in turn in Prayagraj (Allahabad), Haridwar, Ujjain and Nashik.
items: The holy dip
Hindus believe that bathing in the sacred river during the Kumbh brings spiritual merit. Pilgrims, families and sadhus come from all over India to bathe, pray and listen to teachers.
Amrit Snan

The most important bathing days, when the akharas — the orders of sadhus — go to the river in procession. In Haridwar in 2027 these are 6 March, 8 March and 14 April. They are also the most crowded days.
Kumbh, Ardh Kumbh and Maha Kumbh
Haridwar 2027 is an Ardh Kumbh — a 'half' Kumbh, held between the full Kumbhs. Uttarakhand's Chief Minister has said it will be held as grandly as a full Kumbh.
Har Ki Pauri
Haridwar's most famous ghat on the Ganga and the centre of the Kumbh. Haridwar railway station is the nearest station, and Jolly Grant airport at Dehradun has daily flights to Delhi.

sections.h2: Crowds and safety: an honest answer
sections.text: The UK Foreign Office (advice updated 7 October 2026) asks visitors to take particular care at times of religious significance and notes that stampedes have happened at large religious gatherings. NHS Fit for Travel's advice for the 2025 Kumbh said that accidents and injuries, such as slips, falls, stampedes and road accidents, are common. What we suggest: if crowds worry you, avoid the main Amrit Snan mornings and visit on a quieter bathing day; agree a meeting point with your group; keep copies of your passport and visa and a charged phone; follow police barriers and one-way routes; and stay outside the mela core.
sections.note: We don't promise any event is safe or unsafe. We share the official advice with dates and plan your visit around it with you.

sections.h2: A sample plan: Haridwar Kumbh and Rishikesh from Delhi
sections.lead: Haridwar is the gateway to the Himalaya, so the Kumbh fits easily into a North India trip. Delhi to Haridwar is a long day by car or a few hours by train. A sample plan — we set the exact days around the bathing dates you choose:
items: Day 1 — Delhi to Haridwar
Your private car and driver collect you in Delhi. Your driver's name, photo and car number are shared with you before the trip. Check in to a stay outside the mela core.
Day 2 — Kumbh day
An early walk to the ghats with a local guide, the camps and processions of the day, and the evening Ganga aarti at Har Ki Pauri if crowds allow.
Day 3 — Rishikesh
Laxman Jhula, the riverside ashrams and an optional yoga class — see our Rishikesh yoga retreat guide.
Add Holi or the Taj
Holi 2027 falls on 23 March, inside the Haridwar Kumbh window — see our Holi festival guide. Many guests add Agra and Jaipur, or the Char Dham Yatra later in the year.

sections.h2: What to wear, bring and know
sections.lead: A Kumbh is a religious gathering first and a sight second. A few things make the day easier for you and the pilgrims around you:
items: Clothes
Modest clothing that covers shoulders and knees, closed shoes you don't mind getting wet, and warm layers for January and February nights.
Food, water and health

NHS Fit for Travel's advice for the 2025 Kumbh: take safe food and water precautions at all times. We're not doctors — consult your doctor or a travel-health clinic; see NHS Fit for Travel or CDC Travelers' Health.
Photographs
Ask before you photograph sadhus or pilgrims, and never photograph women bathing. Your guide will tell you where cameras are not welcome.
Visa
Most visitors need an Indian e-Visa. Apply yourself at the official site indianvisaonline.gov.in; beware look-alike sites that charge extra. We are not a visa agency — see our India e-Visa guide.
Registration
Check the official site haridwarkumbh.uk.gov.in for any visitor registration or rules for 2027 before you travel.

faqs: When is the next Kumbh Mela?

In 2027 there are two. Haridwar's Ardh Kumbh runs from 14 January to 20 April 2027, with Amrit Snan days on 6 March, 8 March and 14 April. The Nashik–Trimbakeshwar Simhastha opens on 31 October 2026 and has its main baths on 2 August, 31 August and 11–12 September 2027. Confirm dates on the official sites before you book flights.
Can foreigners attend the Kumbh Mela?

Yes. The Kumbh is open to everyone, and many international visitors come to watch the bathing days and the processions. You need a valid Indian visa or e-Visa — apply yourself at the official site indianvisaonline.gov.in and beware look-alike sites that charge extra. Check haridwarkumbh.uk.gov.in for any visitor registration.

The most important bathing days of a Kumbh, when the akharas (orders of sadhus) go to the river in procession. In Haridwar in 2027 they fall on 6 March (Mahashivratri), 8 March (Phalguna Amavasya) and 14 April (Mesh Sankranti). They are also the most crowded days.
Is the Kumbh Mela safe for tourists?

The UK Foreign Office (advice updated 7 October 2026) asks visitors to take particular care at times of religious significance and notes that stampedes have happened at large religious gatherings. If crowds worry you, visit on a quieter bathing day, keep a meeting point, follow police barriers and stay outside the mela core.
What is the difference between Kumbh, Ardh Kumbh and Maha Kumbh?

An Ardh Kumbh is a 'half' Kumbh, held between the full Kumbhs. Haridwar 2027 is an Ardh Kumbh, though Uttarakhand's Chief Minister has said it will be held as grandly as a full Kumbh. The bathing days and rituals are the same kind in each.
Where should I stay for the Kumbh Mela?

Outside the mela core — hotels near Haridwar or in Rishikesh — so you can rest away from the crowds. Rooms fill early and cost more on bathing days, so book early. We quote stays on request and plan the drive to the ghats with you.
Can I combine the Kumbh with Holi, Rishikesh or the Taj Mahal?

Yes. Holi 2027 falls on 23 March, inside the Haridwar Kumbh window, Rishikesh is next door to Haridwar, and Agra and Jaipur fit before or after. Tell us your dates and we send a day-by-day plan with a private car and driver.
What should I wear and bring?

Modest clothing that covers shoulders and knees, closed shoes, warm layers for January and February nights, copies of your passport and visa and a charged phone. NHS Fit for Travel advises safe food and water precautions at all times; consult your doctor or a travel-health clinic before you go.
